title: Disco Album Cover with Tiger and Woman
coreRelationships: The woman and tiger are positioned in the foreground against a receding background.
The diagonal stripes of the background create a sense of movement and depth.
The bright, saturated colors of the figures contrast sharply with the metallic sheen of the background.
The typography is integrated into the upper left, angled to match the background's dynamic.
